title: Terrified Goose Totem
description: A resource pack making the totem look like a terrified goose
body:
A resource pack changing the texture of the totem to a cartoon style terrified goose. 

Yes this is cursed but why not.

This was originally a Fan art i made for the youtuber [Quark](https://youtube.com/@quarkofficial), and i just wanted to see how it looked as totem.
